description_en: Adds a sensitive field defined by the data classification and grading rules of Data Security Guard
description_zh: 调用AddRecognizeRule接口新增数据保护伞分类分级定义的敏感字段
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public add-recognize-rule --tenant-id 10241024 --account-name dsg-uat --sensitive-name name --template-id e1970541-6cf5-4d23-b101-0000 --node-id 0ce67949-0810-400f-a24a-0000 --node-parent Customer/personal/personal_Natural_Information/personal_basic_profile_information --level 1 --operation-type 0 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddRecognizeRule

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. To obtain the tenant ID, log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console), go to the Data Studio page, click the username in the upper-right corner, and choose Menu > User Info
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID。您可登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入数据开发（DataStudio）页面，单击右上方当前登录用户名称，选择菜单 > 用户信息，获取租户ID
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account that creates the sensitive data recognition rule. Enter the username
parameters.help_zh: 创建敏感数据识别规则的阿里云用户。此处填写用户名称
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: The custom name of the sensitive field. The value must be a string less than 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 自定义的敏感字段名称。输入长度小于128的字符串
parameters.name: sensitive_name

parameters.help_en: The template ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2743948.html operation to obtain the ID of the current default template
parameters.help_zh: 模板ID。调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2743948.html接口获取当前默认的模板ID
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The classification node ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2746850.html operation to obtain all node IDs and select a node to create a sensitive field. Enter the ID of the selected node
parameters.help_zh: 分类结点ID。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2746850.html接口获取所有结点ID，选择一个结点新建敏感字段。此处输入所选的结点ID
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The parent node information of the classification node. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2746850.html operation to obtain the information
parameters.help_zh: 分类结点的父结点信息。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2746850.html接口获取
parameters.name: node_parent

parameters.help_en: The sensitivity level of the sensitive field. Select a level defined in the template for the new sensitive field, such as levels 1 to 10
parameters.help_zh: 敏感字段分级。根据模板定义的分级信息，选择其中一级作为新增敏感字段的等级。例如1~10级
parameters.name: level

parameters.help_en:
The name of the sensitivity level. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2743948.html operation to obtain the name of the selected level in the template.

Note: This parameter is required by the current service. If it is omitted, a 400 error (InternalError.Bad.Parameters: levelName not empty) is returned
parameters.help_zh:
分级名称。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2743948.html接口，获取所选分级在模板中对应的分级名称。

注意：当前服务实际要求提供此参数；省略时返回 400（InternalError.Bad.Parameters：levelName not empty）
parameters.name: level_name

parameters.example: This is a sensitive field that identifies the name.
parameters.help_en: The description of the sensitive field. The value must be a string less than 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 敏感字段描述。长度小于128的字符串
parameters.name: sensitive_description

parameters.help_en:
The operation type. Valid values:
0: OR
1: AND
parameters.help_zh:
运算类型。取值如下：
0：或
1：与
parameters.name: operation_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the sensitive data recognition rule. Valid values:
1: regular expression
2: built-in rule
3: sample library
4: self-generated model
parameters.help_zh:
敏感数据识别规则类型：
1：正则表达式。
2：内置规则。
3：样本库。
4：自生成模型
parameters.name: recognize_rules_type

parameters.help_en: The content of the sensitive data recognition rule. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2747189.html operation and refer to the configuration of the same field in the built-in rules
parameters.help_zh: 敏感数据识别规则内容。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2747189.html接口，参考内置规则同字段的配置
parameters.name: recognize_rules

parameters.help_en: The content recognition configuration. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2747189.html operation and refer to the configuration of the same field in the built-in rules
parameters.help_zh: 内容识别。可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2747189.html接口，参考内置规则的同字段配置
parameters.name: content_scan

parameters.help_en: The hit threshold. If the percentage of sampled data that hits the named entity recognition (NER) model exceeds the threshold, such as 60%, the data is considered to hit the sensitive field. Valid values: an integer from 0 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 命中阈值。若抽样数据中，超过阈值百分比（例如，60%）的数据命中NER模型，则认为命中该敏感字段。取值：0~100之间的整数
parameters.name: hit_threshold

parameters.help_en:
The field scanning configuration. Only the specified fields are recognized.
Format: ${project}.${table}.${field} or ${project}.${schema}.${table}.${field}.
The asterisk () wildcard is supported. For example, default.table.column1 can match default.table.column10 and any other content that follows the asterisk
parameters.help_zh:
字段扫描，仅识别赋值的字段。
取值格式：${项目空间}.${表名}.${字段名}或${项目空间}.${SCHEMA}.${表名}.${字段名}。
支持通配符，如default.table.column1可以匹配default.table.column10等*后面的任意内容
parameters.name: col_scan

parameters.help_en:
The field exclusion configuration. The specified fields are not recognized.
Format: ${project}.${table}.${field} or ${project}.${schema}.${table}.${field}.
The asterisk () wildcard is supported. For example, default.table.column1 can match default.table.column10 and any other content that follows the asterisk
parameters.help_zh:
字段排除，即不识别赋值的字段。
取值格式：${项目空间}.${表名}.${字段名}或${项目空间}.${SCHEMA}.${表名}.${字段名}。
支持通配符，如default.table.column1可以匹配default.table.column10等*后面的任意内容
parameters.name: col_exclude

parameters.help_en: The comment scanning configuration. The value is the text of the comment for each field in your data assets. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 内容扫描。取值为您的数据资产中每个字段注释信息的文本，支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: comment_scan

parameters.help_en:
The status of the sensitive field. Valid values:
0: draft
1: active
parameters.help_zh:
敏感字段的生效状态。取值如下：
0：草稿。
1：生效
parameters.name: status

Data.description_en: The returned result in JSON format

RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，一次请求的唯一标识

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。
true：成功。
false：失败
